verdict.rationale: Meltano projects are explicitly file/config-based (meltano.yml, plugins array) generated via CLI (`meltano init`, `meltano add`), and docs explicitly state projects can be treated like any software project with version control, code review, and CI/CD; community confirms pipelines live in a single git repo including secrets/state/environments. missing for 10: independent hands-on report specifically validating CI/CD workflows in practice beyond the doc claim.
